steps.title: Choose your pet sprite
steps.instruction: Open Scratch and choose a Pet sprite from the sprite library (or keep the cat and rename it 'Pet').
steps.hint: Click the sprite icon in the bottom right to add a new sprite from the library.

steps.title: Add click event
steps.instruction: Click on your Pet sprite to select it. Then drag 'when this sprite clicked' from Events into the coding area.
steps.hint: Look in the Events category (yellow blocks) for the 'when this sprite clicked' block.

steps.title: Make your pet talk
steps.instruction: Add a 'say' block so your pet says 'Hello! I am your pet!' for 2 seconds when clicked.
steps.hint: Find the 'say [ ] for ( ) seconds' block in the Looks category (purple).
steps.blocks_text:
when this sprite clicked
say [Hello! I am your pet!] for (2) seconds

steps.title: Test your pet
steps.instruction: Click on your pet sprite on the stage. Does it say hello? If yes, mark this step as Done!
steps.hint: Click directly on the pet in the stage area (the big white area on the right).
steps.blocks_text:
when this sprite clicked
say [Hello! I am your pet!] for (2) seconds
